title: Transaction drops an explicit minSeqNum of 0; cloneFrom and assembleTransaction rebuild the transaction without it

target.versions_affected: 17.1.0 - 17.4.0 (executed: 17.1.0, 17.2.0, 17.2.1, 17.3.0, 17.4.0); 17.0.x has the same constructor code; 16.3.0 and 16.4.1 are not affected

severity_basis: The Transaction constructor tests the bigint minSeqNum for truthiness, so 0n is dropped: minAccountSequence is undefined and cloneFrom (used by rpc.assembleTransaction, Server.prepareTransaction and AssembledTransaction) rebuilds the transaction without minSeqNum. Under CAP-21 a relaxed-sequence transaction comes back as a strict-sequence one, can then fail with tx_bad_seq, and its hash changes. A regression from the bigint migration.

entries.expected: an explicit minSeqNum of 0 is kept when the transaction is parsed and rebuilt through TransactionBuilder.cloneFrom: the rebuilt transaction is the network's
entries.observed: Executed by the kit (the rebuild fact) on 17.2.0, 17.2.1, 17.3.0 and 17.4.0: the rebuilt transaction has no minSeqNum (cond differs) and another hash, on all four variants (17.2.x read only the Protocol 28 ones); 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1 rebuild it to the network's hash.

evidence.pre_fix: make verify-conformance and the public set: on cap-0021/precond-v2-min-seq-num-zero (a local stellar-core ledger whose transaction carries PRECOND_V2 with minSeqNum 0), the rebuild fact of the focus transaction diverges on 17.2.0, 17.2.1, 17.3.0 and 17.4.0: TransactionBuilder.cloneFrom builds the transaction without minSeqNum (cond differs); 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1 rebuild it to the network's hash. The issue's script on 17.1.0 to 17.4.0: the parsed minAccountSequence is undefined (16.3.0: "0") and the clone's hash differs (16.3.0: equal). main 5243062f has the same code (src/base/transaction.ts#L151-L154, transaction_builder.ts#L398).
evidence.expected_basis: CAP-21: a present minSeqNum of 0 accepts any source sequence below the transaction's sequence; an absent one requires exactly seqNum - 1, so dropping it changes the transaction's meaning and hash.

reproduction.method: make verify-conformance OFFLINE=1 and xdrcheck conform run --set public: the rebuild fact diverges on every 17.x column and conforms on every 16.x column; re-run by hand on 2026-11-18 with the issue's script on 17.4.0.

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-18: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-14 as https://github.com/stellar/js-stellar-sdk/issues/1904; this record restates the public issue.

Now executed by the kit: cap-0021/precond-v2-min-seq-num-zero (generated on a local stellar-core) and the driver protocol's rebuild fact show the defect, and the entry declares it as a known divergence.
